### The True Vine - Greg Laurie Devotion - January 23, 2025
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-january-23-2025.html
Passage: John 15:5
Points:
- Believers cannot survive spiritually or produce genuine fruit without staying connected to Jesus.
- Outward religious performance can seem productive while lacking real spiritual life.
- Daily spiritual disciplines such as Scripture reading, prayer, and fellowship maintain connection to Christ.
- God prunes fruitful believers to cut away unproductive distractions and maximize spiritual growth.

### Abiding in the Vine
Author: Melissa Kruger
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abiding-in-the-vine
Passage: John 15:5–8
Points:
- Just as severed grapevines wither and become useless, people have no spiritual vitality apart from Jesus.
- Abiding in Christ requires cultivating daily habits of Scripture meditation and regular prayer.
- Communing with the Lord renews our thinking and aligns our desires with God's glory.
- Staying attached to the Vine connects believers to one another within the local church.
